interpretation: Quantities the write-up derives in prose rather than reading off an artifact. The first paper-scoped claims guard found 53 of 120 figures resolving to nothing, including the headline 21.6-point ranking gap and the 8.4% family-wide certified acceptance; these are those figures, computed once, in a committed script, each stamped with the construction, delta, allocation, n and prefix length that produced it. Two prefix lengths are emitted because the write-up is NOT internally consistent about which one 'at the floor' means: 0.0925 is the figure at k = 280, the smallest prefix meeting the 0.20 floor, while the 18,000-group and 12.9x extrapolation reconciles at k = 279, which does not meet it. Selecting one here would conceal that. Nothing here selects a threshold or issues a certificate.

at_the_acceptance_floor.k_definition: ceil(acceptance_floor * n) -- the smallest prefix that MEETS the 0.20 floor

one_group_below_the_floor.k_definition: ceil(acceptance_floor * n) - 1 -- does NOT meet the floor. Emitted because the write-up's 18,000-group and 12.9x figures reconcile here and not at the floor.

shortfalls.note: Differences between three committed acceptance readings, all over the same n. Each input is itself stamped in calibration_diagnostics.json.
